runtime_preference: local_python_cli + file_storage; no unnecessary cloud deps

components.name: Snapshot & Contract Registry
components.responsibility: Register project snapshot: allowed-file list, SHA-256 hashes, run contract, config. Produces immutable baseline record.
components.trust_boundary: Read-only over snapshot; writes only to LabOps workspace (never to project snapshot)

components.name: Evidence Collector
components.responsibility: Scan allowed files, extract strong/weak/missing evidence, reference evidence_id + file/line/cell.
components.trust_boundary: Read-only over allowed files; NEVER reads excluded data (CSV/labels/keys)
components.mvp_nature: REAL (rule-based extraction driven by audit JSON inputs)

components.name: Diagnosis Candidate Engine
components.responsibility: Produce diagnostic candidates from evidence. Every candidate MUST cite evidence_id; no evidence -> UNKNOWN/BLOCKED.
components.trust_boundary: Deterministic rules only; cannot fabricate facts
components.mvp_nature: REAL (rule-based; no ML, no optimization suggestions)

components.name: Approval Gate
components.responsibility: Classify each action (read-only auto / high-risk manual / forbidden). Emit approval requests; track approve/reject/timeout.
components.trust_boundary: No action executes without approved decision; rejection is first-class
components.mvp_nature: REAL for policy enforcement; APPROVAL_TRIGGER uses SIMULATED adapter in demo (no real network/install)

components.name: Controlled Action Executor
components.responsibility: Execute approved actions under dry-run-first, command allowlist, workdir boundary, timeout, output truncation/redaction.
components.trust_boundary: Executes ONLY approved actions; forbidden actions refused even if approved
components.mvp_nature: MIXED: REAL for benign file/hash ops; SIMULATED adapter for install/download/train (demo only, no real execution)

components.name: Verification Closer
components.responsibility: Verify post-action state (exit code, artifact existence, hash) before closing loop. Verification failure is first-class.

components.name: Append-only Trace Log
components.responsibility: Record every step (registry, evidence, diagnosis, approval, action, verification) in append-only log with timestamps + hashes.
components.trust_boundary: Write-only append; no modification/deletion of prior entries

components.name: Demo Harness (polar-baseline scenario)
components.responsibility: Drive a guided demo using real polar-baseline evidence gaps: identify missing evidence + approval loop. No fabricated faults, no test-label reads.
components.trust_boundary: Demo shows missing-evidence identification + approval closure only
components.mvp_nature: MIXED: SIMULATED adapters for install/download; REAL for evidence-gap detection

data_flow: snapshot_registry -> evidence_collector -> diagnosis_engine -> approval_gate -> action_executor -> verification_closer
trace_log receives events from every component (fan-in, append-only)
trust_boundaries_summary: LabOps workspace writable; project snapshot + excluded data read-only / not read
Action executor never bypasses approval_gate; forbidden actions always refused
Diagnosis engine never fabricates; no evidence -> UNKNOWN/BLOCKED

mvp_adapter_notation.REAL: implemented with actual local logic (hash, read, rule-based classification)
mvp_adapter_notation.SIMULATED: demo-only adapter that records the intended effect without performing the real external/risky action (e.g., pretend-install, pretend-download)
mvp_adapter_notation.MIXED: combination; real for benign ops, simulated for risky ops
